Bash(git commit -m "$(cat <<''EOF''
Fix video processing pipeline reliability issues

Three critical fixes for _continue_after_masks in SAM2 workflow:

1. HTTPS URL Download (lines 2230-2241)
   - cv2.VideoCapture is unreliable when streaming from remote HTTPS URLs
   - Metadata reads work (short reads) but full frame streaming fails with
     "partial file" errors causing 0 frames to be read
   - Now downloads HTTPS URLs to local temp file before processing
   - Matches existing pattern used for Railway paths (/data/...)

2. Frame Preload Validation (lines 2559-2561)
   - Previously, if cv2.VideoCapture.read() returned ret=False, frames were
     silently skipped leaving gaps in preloaded_frames dictionary
   - This caused cryptic KeyError exceptions later during segment processing
     (e.g., KeyError: 489, KeyError: 526)
   - Now validates all expected frames were loaded and fails early with
     clear error: "Could not read all video frames: got X/Y"

3. FFmpeg Stderr Deadlock Fix (line 2845)
   - Using stderr=subprocess.PIPE without draining it causes deadlock on Windows
   - When FFmpeg writes warnings to stderr, the 64KB pipe buffer fills up
   - FFmpeg blocks waiting for buffer to drain, Python blocks on stdin.write
   - Changed to stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL to prevent deadlock
   - Updated error handlers to not rely on stderr output

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
)")
